# Benchmark baseline of internal/bid on darwin/arm64 (targets T1.6.4 and T13).
#
# Taken on 2026-11-10 at 2cd8a3184f (branch perf/t13-final), with
#   go test -c -o bid.test internal/bid
#   ./bid.test -test.run XXX -test.bench BenchmarkKernel -test.benchmem \
#       -test.count 8 -test.benchtime 100ms
# in the directory src/internal/bid, and the lines below are that output
# unedited. The file is in benchstat form; compare a later run with
#   benchstat testdata/bench_baseline_darwin_arm64.txt new.txt
#
# Machine: 16-core Apple M4 Max under macOS 26, with no other builds or
# benchmarks running. Load average (uptime, 1, 5 and 15 minutes) was
# 8.63 37.74 45.96 at the start of the run and 9.27 21.63 36.56 at its end; the residual
# load is the machine's resident daemons (security scanning, indexing, a
# VM), about five cores of steady background work that single-threaded
# benchmarks on the remaining cores do not contend with.
#
# Rows are Op/Width/Class. Width 64 and 128 are the decimal kernel; float64 is
# the reference row, where the language has a counterpart. Every row includes
# a loop floor of about 0.3 ns (the float64 add row is nearly all floor).
#
# The ratchet is TestBenchRatchet, opt-in:
#   go test -run TestBenchRatchet internal/bid -args -bid.ratchet
# It measures each row in short runs and takes the smallest time, as it does
# for the samples below. A row fails when its time is over
#   baseline * (1 + ratchet-band) + ratchet-slack-ns
# or when it allocates. The band is 10%: tighter than the 20% of the
# provisional baselines this file replaces, wider than the 5% they asked for,
# because the residual daemon load above moves sub-5-ns rows by a few
# percent between runs on this machine. The slack stands for the timer
# resolution on rows of about a nanosecond. The baseline moves only by a
# deliberate commit that replaces this file.
#
# ratchet-band: 0.10
# ratchet-slack-ns: 0.5
#
# linux/amd64: not recorded here. Its baseline is the file
# testdata/bench_baseline_linux_amd64.txt, taken by the CI of that platform;
# the ratchet skips a platform with no file.
#
# History: the provisional baseline of 2026-10-31 (73a8a451d3, load 18-31)
# and its appended refreshes are in this file's git history.
goos: darwin
goarch: arm64
pkg: internal/bid
